name: Odin Novasacht
source:
A man who randomly came across Shira and his friends on the way home. His demeanor was slightly intimidating for them.

[spoiler]The perpetrator behind Arc I's events, and the puppeteer of the false religious cult, the Weeping Angels. He executed a series of plans over a span of several years to help free Helix from her prison, and set the future down a correct path.[/spoiler]

A man who randomly came across Shira and his friends on the way home. His demeanor was slightly intimidating for them.

[spoiler]The perpetrator behind Arc I's events, and the puppeteer of the false religious cult, the Weeping Angels. He executed a series of plans over a span of several years to help free Helix from her prison, and set the future down a correct path.[/spoiler]
